sql:
SELECT `ts`.`session_no`, `ts`.`session_name`, `tc`.`course_name`, `ts`.`start_date`, `ts`.`end_date`, `ts`.`session_status`
FROM `training_session` AS `ts`
INNER JOIN `training_course` AS `tc` ON `ts`.`course_id` = `tc`.`id`
WHERE `ts`.`training_year` = 2026
ORDER BY `ts`.`start_date`
LIMIT 200

SELECT `training_year`, COUNT(*) AS `场次数`
FROM `training_session`
GROUP BY `training_year`
ORDER BY `training_year` DESC

SELECT `session_no`, `session_name`, `training_year`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `session_status`, `trainer_name`, `training_location`
FROM `training_session`
WHERE `training_year` = 2026
ORDER BY `start_date` ASC

SELECT `session_no`, `session_name`, `training_year`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `session_status`, `trainer_name`, `training_location`
FROM `training_session`
WHERE `training_year` = 2025
ORDER BY `start_date` ASC
